The Sky Gradient method is a common technique in computer graphics for generating simple sky backgrounds.
It is often used in ray marching demos and voxel engines due to its simplicity and visual appeal.
The technique is widely used in indie games and real-time rendering applications where performance is critical and physical accuracy is not the primary goal.
